tagline: Every requirement. Its source. Your evidence.
description: Upload a tender pack and supporting documents. Get a page-cited checklist, possible evidence matches, and clearly marked gaps to review.
boundaryBody: Results are suggestions. There is no verdict on legal compliance, eligibility, or who will win. You make the final call.
notOfficial: Not an official portal and not connected to etender.gov.az.
demoHint: This loads the invented tender stored with the app. It is not a live company document.
sampleTitle: This card did not come from an analysis
sampleBody: The lines below show the shape of a review. No file was read and no model was called.
sampleRequirement: The bidder must provide a copy of the registration certificate.
sampleQuote: The bidder must provide a copy of the tax registration certificate.
waitingWorker: The job is queued. If this does not change, check that the worker process is running.
stale: This is taking longer than expected. Refresh the page. The files are still stored.
demoExtractor: Demo extractor (no live model). Suggestions are rule-based and still need review.
unreadable: An unreadable page was not hidden. OCR is off in this demo, so a scan is not treated as parsed.
duplicate: A byte-for-byte copy was kept and was not merged.
noRequirements: No requirement was extracted from the readable pages. An empty list is not a success.
notFound: Not found in the uploaded files
notFoundDetail: This does not mean the supplier lacks the document.
evidenceHint: Attach certificates and contracts to this check.
loadFailed: The analysis could not be read.
confirmDelete: Delete this analysis and the uploaded files?
noteRequired: Write a short note before marking a row not applicable.
statementRequired: Write the corrected requirement before saving an edit.
apiDown: The API is not responding. If the backend is starting, try again in a moment.

evidenceStatus.not_found: Not found in the uploaded files

errors.unsupported_file_type: Only PDFs are accepted. The extension and the file contents need to match.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than the demo limit.
errors.page_limit_exceeded: The page count is above the demo limit.
errors.pdf_encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Remove the password and upload it again.
errors.pdf_unreadable: The PDF could not be read, or it has no usable text.
errors.ocr_unavailable: A scanned page is not readable in this demo.
errors.model_rate_limited: The model provider rate-limited the request. Wait and retry.
errors.model_timeout: The model did not answer in time. You can retry.
errors.model_output_invalid: The model response could not be used. No partial checklist was saved.
errors.analysis_not_found: That analysis does not exist, or it was deleted.
errors.export_failed: Export is not ready. A checklist has to exist first.
errors.generic: That action failed. Files were not replaced with an empty checklist.
errors.api_down: The API is not responding. If the backend is starting, try again in a moment.
